screens.name: Project list with filters

empty.copy: No projects match these filters. [Clear filters]
empty.behavior: EmptyState with a secondary Button that resets status to all and clears the search

loading.behavior: existing Spinner; filters disabled until the list arrives

error.behavior: existing Alert tone danger; filters hidden

success.behavior: list filtered as the user types; count updates

partial.not_applicable: the list loads in one response; there is no paging

permission-denied.not_applicable: every signed-in user may see the project list

keyboard: Tab order: search, status select, results; Escape in the search clears it; focus ring --color-focus
screen_reader: Both controls keep their visible <label>; the count sits in a role=status region (polite)
responsive: < 640px: filters stack above the list; controls at least 44px high
